task.prompt: Find ACME Corp's total revenue for fiscal year 2025. Report a single dollar figure and say where it came from.
task.expected: $4.82 billion (FY2025 results press release, investor relations)

outcome.answer: ACME Corp reported total revenue of $4.82 billion for fiscal year 2025 (up 11% year over year), per the FY2025 results release on ir.acmecorp.com.

steps.name: plan
steps.input: 1) Search for ACME Corp's FY2025 annual results. 2) Open the investor-relations press release or 10-K. 3) Extract total revenue from the full-year highlights. 4) Report the figure with its source.
steps.output: Plan set. Starting with a targeted search of investor sources.

steps.name: web_search
steps.input: ACME Corp FY2025 annual results total revenue investor relations
steps.output: [1] ir.acmecorp.com — "ACME Corp Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year Fiscal 2025 Results" | [2] marketpulse.io — "ACME beats estimates as cloud unit accelerates" | [3] financeblog.net — "What ACME's monster 2025 really means for shareholders" | [4] wikipedia.org — ACME Corp

steps.name: select_result
steps.input: Open result [1]: ir.acmecorp.com — the official FY2025 results press release from investor relations.
steps.output: Selected https://ir.acmecorp.com/news/fy2025-results (primary source: company investor-relations newsroom, dated 2025-05-22).

steps.name: open_page
steps.output: ACME Corp Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year Fiscal 2025 Results. Full year fiscal 2025 highlights: Total revenue of $4.82 billion, up 11% year over year. GAAP operating margin of 18.4%. Fourth quarter revenue of $1.31 billion, up 9% year over year. Cash and equivalents of $2.1 billion at year end.

steps.name: reason
steps.output: Press releases and the 10-K state total revenue verbatim; secondary coverage rounds or hedges. If the IR release and any secondary figure disagree, the IR number wins. Worth checking that the figure is GAAP revenue rather than bookings or ARR, since coverage often conflates the three, and that the fiscal year actually matches the calendar label.

steps.name: final_answer
steps.input: Compose the final answer from the verified findings.
steps.output: ACME Corp reported total revenue of $4.82 billion for fiscal year 2025 (up 11% year over year), per the FY2025 results release on ir.acmecorp.com.
